name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press With Rotation
setup: Set the position the variation names, body in one long line, and start breathing before the clock starts.
cues: Tuck your belt buckle up and keep the down knee heavy on the floor the whole set.
Brace for a light punch, then keep breathing behind it.
Hold still: nothing moves but the air.

faults.fix: Tuck the belt buckle toward your chin and push the floor away.
Breathe in through the nose, out long, without the line moving.
